resolved_findings.evidence: extract_tiled_features white-pads the global grid with an 8-patch halo, extracts 64x64x3 (896x896 pixel) tiles and retains central 48x48 cores. Cores advance by 48 patches (672px); coverage rejects holes or overlap. Tests check exact tile shape on odd/large and tiny inputs, white padding, and exact coverage.

resolved_findings.status: Resolved in source; equality test present
resolved_findings.evidence: Development calls score_known_sparse for reviewed native coordinates only. It predicts unique floor/ceil grid neighbors in bounded batches, then uses cv2.INTER_LINEAR remapping. A deterministic fixture asserts array equality with full-grid prediction followed by native remapping.

resolved_findings.issue: Support gate and fit-asset integrity before DINO load
resolved_findings.evidence: The trainer verifies pinned fit manifest and split safety, then exact support-proof digest, matching manifest, passed >=30 dual-query/>=10-document gate, then exact 566-asset proof and recomputed image/mask byte map. Only afterward does it construct the verified DINO probe.

resolved_findings.issue: Sampling, seed, positive-only handling, and metadata audit
resolved_findings.evidence: Rows sort by document ID then query ID; seeds are 45+sorted index. Sampling selects reviewed pixels from distinct pure tokens, excludes mixed-label tokens, and retains positive-only queries without fabricated negatives. Metadata records sampled/dual/positive-only/skipped IDs and per-query seed, native coordinates, patch indices and centers, class counts, and weights.

resolved_findings.status: Resolved for model and sparse caches
resolved_findings.evidence: After joblib serialization, a JSON sidecar records the actual file SHA-256; loading rechecks it and matches sidecar against embedded metadata. Cache report includes protocol/manifests/model/source/support/asset hashes and per-cache digests plus a canonical cache map.
The protocol names original CNN and exact-crop HGB artifacts, digests, caches, reports, and split hashes; it explicitly warns against using the alternate HGB model.
